text:
alex: FYI — after the eu-west hiccup I'm seeing a spike of GPU pods stuck Pending. Scheduler says Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu even though some nodes report free MIG slices.

marta: same. CA started scale-up but pods didnt land. looks like allocation mismatch between MIG shapes and pod requests :confused:

raj: are we mixing MIG and time-slicing pools in the same nodepool? that usually confuses binpacking and CA heuristics — kube-scheduler sees capacity but it's not compatible with the pod's slice size.

sophia: CA log snippet: 
```
I0412 09:03:12 cluster-autoscaler.go:123] Scale-up: triggered for deployment/vision (need 3 nodes). Reason: pod requires nvidia.com/mig-1g.5gb but candidate node has only mig-2g.10gb available
```

kim: interesting — we recently enabled time-slice on pool-shared-eu which leaves nodes with fractional GPU but kubelet advertises generic nvidia.com/gpu. Pod requests use explicit mig labels, so mismatch.

alex: quick diagnostic commands I ran: 
```
kubectl get nodes -l gpu-pool=shared -o wide
kubectl describe pod vision-trainer-0 -n ml | sed -n '1,120p'
kubectl logs -n kube-system cluster-autoscaler-xyz | tail -n 200
```

marta: workaround that worked for a couple pods: created a tiny dedicated nodepool with explicit MIG config (1g) and nodeSelector: gpu-shape=1g. Pods scheduled there instantly. But cost goes up.

raj: long term we should:
- stop mixing MIG/time-slice modes in a single CA-managed nodepool
- add nodeAffinity/taints so pods land only on compatible pools
- teach CA about mig flavors (file an issue upstream?)

sophia: also to reduce churn: bump scale-down delay and increase unsched-pod time threshold so CA doesn't flip flops during AZ unstable periods. Current --scale-down-unneeded-time is 10m, maybe raise to 20m.

kim: tradeoffs: dedicated small pools reduce latency and fragmentation but increase reserved capacity cost. Could auto-create short-lived dedicated pools for heavy batch runs via a controller.

alex: action items: raj to prototype a dedicated mig-1g nodepool + taint today, marta to update helm values for CA scale-down in staging, sophia to open an upstream issue for CA -> mig-awareness. I'll monitor the cluster and revert if anything breaks.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for infra/scale-adjust (pr/412) by raj — ETA ~5m :rocket:

marta: 👍 testing results so far: two blocked pods cleared after the dedicated pool spun up. We'll watch cost impact this week. :eyes:

raj: I'll post the terraform diff in #eng-infra later. If anyone wants to try the quick repro: set a pod with request "nvidia.com/mig-1g.5gb: 1" and attempt to schedule on shared pool.

alex: thanks all — keep updates short here. If we see repeated episodes, we'll schedule a deeper retro. :calendar:
